text: This report provides the Board of Health with an update on the risk management reporting as part of the Ontario Public Health Accountability Framework requirements. Toronto Public Health (TPH) faces a range of risks that may impact achievement of its strategic objectives. In 2017, TPH developed an Enterprise Risk Management Framework to standardize the management (identification, assessment, prioritization, and evaluation) of risks at TPH. This framework increases TPH's likelihood of achieving its objectives, improves the identification of opportunities and threats, and supports effective and efficient resource allocation. Risk management is a requirement under the new Ontario Public Health Accountability Framework requirements. Public health units are required to annually submit a Risk Management Report to the Ministry of Health and Long-Term Care.
The Board of Health received the report (November 7, 2018) from the Medical Officer of Health for information.
